THIS MFA IS FILED U/S.173 (1) OF MOTOR VEHICLES ACT,
1988, AGAINST THE JUDGMENT AND AWARD DATED 11.01.2021 PASSED IN MVC NO.138/2018 ON THE FILE OF THE SENIOR CIVIL JUDGE AND JUDICIAL MAGISTRATE FIRST CLASS, LAXMESHWAR,
PARTLY ALLOWING THE CLAIM PETITION FOR COMPENSATION AND SEEKING ENHANCEMENT OF COMPENSATION.

THIS APPEAL, COMING ON FOR ADMISSION, THIS DAY, THE COURT DELIVERED THE FOLLOWING:
 ORAL JUDGMENT 1.

This appeal is filed by the injured claimant seeking enhancement of compensation being aggrieved by the judgment and award dated 11.01.2021, passed in MVC No.138/2018 on the file of the Senior Civil Judge and JMFC, Laxmeshwar.

2. Shri Pruthvi K.S., learned counsel for the appellant submits that the Tribunal committed an error in assessing income as well as the disability and had awarded meager compensation on all other heads.
Hence, he seeks for allowing of the appeal.

3. Per contra, Shri M.Y. Katagi, learned counsel for respondent No.1 and Shri S.S. Koliwad, learned counsel for respondent No.2 in chorus submits that the compensation awarded by the Tribunal is just and proper NC: 2024:KHC-D:11485 and it does not call for any enhancement.
Thus, they seeks for dismissal of the appeal.

4. Heard the learned counsel appearing for the parties and having perused the appeal papers meticulously.
5.
The pleadings and evidence on record indicate that in a road traffic accident which occurred on 17.09.2017, the claimant had suffered fracture of proximal end of tibia and clavicle bone.
In support of the same, the claimant examined the Doctor Veereshkumar Karbasappa Shettar as PW2 and produced the disability certificate.
Taking note of the injuries suffered by the claimant, Tribunal assessed disability at 18%.
I am of the considered view that it would be just and appropriate to reassess the disability of the claimant at 20%.
This Court reassess the notional income of the deceased at Rs.10,250/- p.m. placing reliance on the Notional Income Chart prepared by the KSLSA.

Further, the Tribunal has rightly applied the multiplier based on the age of the NC:
2024:KHC-D:11485 claimant at the time of accident.
Thus, the loss of income due to disability is reassessed at Rs.4,18,200/- (Rs.10,250/- x 12 x 17 x 20%).

2 6.

Taking note of the treatment provided to the injured-appellant/claimant, this Court reassess the compensation awarded under the head "Pain & Suffering"
at Rs.40,000/-.

Admittedly, the appellant was taken treatment as an inpatient for 40 days and taking note of the same, a sum of Rs.15,000/- is awarded towards "food,
nourishment and attendant charges".

Further, the compensation of Rs.28,042/-
towards "medical expenses" and Rs.30,000/- towards "loss of amenities"
awarded by the Tribunal are retained as it is.

7. Further, the appellant has sustained the aforesaid injuries and fractures and was admitted as an inpatient in the Hospital for a substantial period, hence, I am of the considered view that the injured- appellant/claimant requires at least three month period to recover, so it would be just and proper to award NC: 2024:KHC-D:11485 Rs.30,750/- (Rs.10,250/- x 3 months) under the head "loss of income during the period of treatment".

8. Thus, the injured-appellant/claimant would be entitled to modified compensation on the following heads:
 Particulars Amount  (in Rs.)
 Towards disability Rs.4,18,200 /-
 Towards pain and suffering Rs.40,000/-

Towards loss of amenities Rs.30.000/-
 Towards medical expenses Rs.28,042/-
 Loss of income during laid up Rs.30,750/-
 period

Food, nourishment and attendant Rs.15,000/-
 charges  Total Rs.5,61,992/-
9.
Thus, the injured-appellant/claimant would be entitled to total compensation of Rs.5,61,992/- as against Rs.1,85,042/- awarded by the Tribunal.

10. In the result, the following:
ORDER (i) The appeal stands allowed in part.

(ii) The impugned judgment and award of the Tribunal is modified to an extent that the NC: 2024:KHC-D:11485 injured-appellant/claimant would be entitled to total compensation of Rs.5,61,992/- as against Rs.1,85,042/- awarded by the Tribunal.

from the date of petition till the date of payment.

(iv) The respondent - Corporation to pay the entire compensation amount along with interest to the injured-appellant/claimant within a period of six weeks from the date of receipt of a certified copy of this judgment.
(v) Apportionment, deposit and disbursement shall be made as per the award of the Tribunal.
(vi) Draw modified award accordingly.
